Subject: Subprocessor roster & cross-border controls for EU customers

Hi Marcus,

We're kicking off a review ahead of our pilot (DataCove x Redwood) and need a current copy of your subprocessor roster plus a brief explanation of how EU customer traffic is routed and protected when it crosses to non‑EEA providers. Specifically we need:

- A list of subprocessors (name, country, service type, last SOC 2 date if available)
- Which subprocessors may process plaintext request content or logs
- The contractual transfer mechanisms in place (SCCs, UK Addendum, adequacy, or DPA addendum)
- Any planned additions in the next 60 days that could affect residency

I've attached our standard processor questionnaire as a PDF — take whatever format is easiest. We're aiming to complete internal approvals by 31 Jul; would appreciate a reply with roster + controls note by next Tue (24 Jul).

Attachment: DataCove_Processor_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

Thanks,

— Samira Khan
DataOps Counsel, DataCove Analytics
legal@datacove.io
+44 20 7946 0815

We can get a current roster to you today and include a short writeup on transfer mechanisms. Quick notes up front:

- Redwood maintains SCCs and an EU DPA addendum option; we also support UK Addendum where required.
- For EU tenants opting into residency, primary serving stays in EU regions; non‑EU subprocessors are only used for ancillary observability and analytics unless a customer explicitly enables cross‑region backup/DR.

I'll send the roster as an attachment once Kim/Naomi confirm final fields. If you require a DocuSign route for an addendum, let us know the recipient name and we'll open the route — we typically handle those through Sales Legal.

Hi Samira / Marcus,

Thanks — attaching the current roster and a short tech note. Below are the highlights you requested.

1) Current roster (attached: redwood_subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx) — key entries:
   - FastEdge CDN (EU: Ireland) — caching, no persistent logs forwarded to non‑EEA; SOC 2 Type II 2027
   - CacheMetrics (US) — aggregated observability only, no request payloads (SOC 2 2026)
   - KeyVault Partners (US/EU) — key storage; HSM/KMS backed; keys separated per tenant
   - LogStore (US) — optional logs for debugging; encrypted at rest with restricted access

2) Data flows and controls:
   - EU customer traffic stays in EU when residency is enabled. Cross‑region backup and analytics are performed on pseudonymized/hashed artifacts unless a customer has opted into cross‑region support.
   - All cross‑border transfers use SCCs where applicable. We maintain an internal addendum mapping that can be surfaced; we also support signing customer DPA addenda via DocuSign (link below).

3) Planned near‑term changes (<=60 days):
   - Adding a new observability pipeline (Observiq) for burst analytics. It will be US‑based but will only receive aggregated metrics; we will update the roster prior to cutover.

Next steps we suggest:
- I'll share the roster and a short redlined DPA addendum template if you want to propose any edits.
- If DataCove needs SCCs + UK Addendum proof, let us know the scope and we'll attach the clauses.

Attachments:
- redwood_subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 45 KB)
- redwood_eu-us-dataflow-diagram.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
- DPA_Addendum_DocuSign_Link.txt (plain text with signing link)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Hi Priya — great questions. Quick answers and action items below.

- CacheMetrics: does NOT receive raw request bodies. It ingests sampled telemetry (metrics, counters, anonymized traces). We'll include a confirmation statement in the DPA addendum text.
- LogStore: retention is default 30 days for debug logs (configurable per customer). Access is limited to on‑call engineering and a small set of third‑party support engineers; access requires approval and is audited.

Action items:
- Kimberly: please append the two confirmation lines to the roster and addendum, then I'll route the DocuSign to Samira (legal@datacove.io).
- Naomi: please be ready to share the export controls snippet for UK Addendum clause if DataCove requests it on the call.
- Priya / Samira: Tue 24 Jul 09:30–10:00 UTC works for Marcus and our Privacy team — Marcus will send calendar invite once Kimberly confirms the DocuSign routing.

Thanks all — looking forward to the call.

Best,
